assumptions: A level tabletop and gravity retain the loose chick; the product is not claimed captive when lifted.
Digital geometry proves dimensions, clearances, non-overlap, and presentation states, not printed friction or balance performance.

components.form: A single 24 mm-deep owl silhouette with flat print back, recessed face, two broad feet, a smooth belly bridge, and 7 mm side stop walls.
components.interfaces: Open 54 mm belly corridor; broad bridge above the chick; stop walls retain lateral travel by geometry and gravity.
components.name: Owl body, bridge, feet, and stops
components.placement: Upright around the chick on a level tabletop.
components.purpose: The friendly outer character rocks between two broad feet while its open belly exposes the cam action.

components.form: A single rounded triangular cam with flat print back, broad exposed face, recessed chick features, and one high central lobe.
components.interfaces: Rolls laterally over 16.4 mm between stop states; 0.8 mm clearance remains to the corresponding side stop at either endpoint.
components.name: Chick roller cam
components.placement: Loose beneath the owl bridge, centered through depth with 0.8 mm running gap at both faces.
components.purpose: The nested character receives the thumb stroke and shifts the owl's support point.

concept.intended_interaction: Stand the nested pair upright, roll the chick from one broad side stop through center to the other, watch the owl tip and land on the opposite foot, then roll back to reset.
concept.signature_decision: Make the removable chick simultaneously the character, tabletop roller, lifting cam, and endpoint actuator, with no hidden linkage or axle.
concept.summary: A palm-sized two-piece owl desk toy whose loose nested chick is the visible axleless cam: one thumb rolls it laterally under the open belly bridge, shifting support so the owl rocks from one broad foot to the other.
concept.title: Neststomp
unresolved_risks: Physical printing is required to verify that friction and center of mass produce smooth rolling, stable endpoint landings, and audible or tactile stomp quality without binding or sliding.

research.note: Spark Make trusts the Wish's cited relatives; no new externally sourced design claim is added. Geometry and digital checks establish only the exact CAD relationships, not physical performance.
